status: Exploratory follow-up protocol fixed after primary results were observed, before fragment predictions. Not an independent preregistration.
cases: All 200 cold_indexed cases in frozen public pilot, same training and heldout pairs; no exclusions based on results.
source_library: Only the 14 accepted programs learned in the primary pilot from source train tasks; original reference programs ignored. Original family and example-pair exclusions retained.
fragment_rule: All actual AST subtrees plus all nonempty proper prefixes of existing pipelines. Unique ASTs ordered by existing structural cost then canonical JSON. No primitive invented; no target program hard-coded.
composition: Use learned fragment output signatures and training-target-derived literals to search concatenations with the existing residual prefix index. If no fit, run cold solver with candidates and checks reduced by already-consumed counts.
budget_accounting: Every reused program, subprogram, or literal counts as one candidate and one evaluation per training example; matching checks, index items, and states recorded. This is a dual candidate/check budget, not a universal machine-instruction budget. Full wall time includes enumeration, hashing, filtering, literal generation, verification, and indexing. Source discovery and fragment extraction added to lifetime costs. Test-only reporting evaluation is excluded from learner time for every method.
whole_cache_control: Charges whole-program tests against candidate budget before cold fallback; slightly stricter than original main-pilot cache implementation. Do not overwrite or silently replace original results.
outcomes: total measured lifetime learning time and counters
no_tuning: One frozen protocol; keep every failure and negative-transfer case. No grammar or budget updates after observing outcomes.
scope: Public PBE task replay; 200 seed-task trials are not 200 independent task families. No production deployment, broad general-intelligence claim, or independent out-of-domain validation.
